# Start a software timer

Arms a software timer: d0 = event id, d1 = duration in ms.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x612970e8` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Menus arm event id 500 from 89 sites, each passing 8000 ms. The value is a signed 16-bit immediate, so a byte patch reaches 32767 ms at most.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): Picture Mode stayed open 30 s after its arms were changed; other screens kept 8 s. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
